notes.title: New Version
notes.notes:
The battle reaches new heights! The latest update for Rage of Tower introduces powerful new features, rebalances key systems, and unleashes fresh content that will test even the most seasoned defenders. It’s time to rethink your strategy — the tower calls!

🔥 New Content

10 New Tower Types with unique abilities and upgrade paths (e.g., Drone Tower, Tesla Coil, Air Strike, Supporter Tower)

New Enemy Faction: Destroyer Helicopters

Playable Tanks 

⚙️ Gameplay & Balance Improvements

Reworked tower upgrade system with branching specializations

Improved enemy AI pathfinding and tower target logic

🎨 Visual & UI Enhancements

New tower attack effects and explosion animations

Revamped UI for tower placement and upgrades

Added in-game minimap and enemy route highlighting

Art Style Changed from stylize to realistic

and more .....

🛠️ QoL + Fixes

Bug fixes for tower placement glitches

Optimized performance on lower-end systems

Shorter load times and smoother framerate




          Game Have Been Changed

               Best Tower Defense                first hybrid Tower Defense
